judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.B. 116, the Ohio Blockchain Basics Act, which barred state and local governments from impairing a person's ability to accept digital assets as payment or to hold their own digital assets in a hardware or self-hosted wallet. It also barred taxes and fees aimed specifically at paying with digital assets, and created a state income tax deduction for capital gains on digital assets spent on goods or services in transactions up to $200. It let individuals mine digital assets in residential areas subject to local ordinances, let mining businesses operate in industrial zones, and exempted mining and staking from money transmitter licensing. It passed the Ohio House 70-26.
